svg.title: Centrifuge
svg.desc: Benchtop microcentrifuge with open lid, rotor, tube positions, hinge, control panel, and safety latch. Biological basis: A centrifuge rotor subjects samples to radial acceleration; balanced tube placement and a locking lid are essential operating features.
